title: Activation Control Room: Roadmap Signals & Launch Readiness Ledger
body:
Purpose:
This doc is a compact, operational-first ledger intended for the "Activation Control Room" during feature launches and roadmap milestones. It’s a working single-source for signal definitions, KPI thresholds, immediate runbook steps, and owner contacts for the first 72h of traffic ramp.

Scope & Audience:
- Scope: staged feature activations (hosted API + dedicated), canary rollouts, beta customer ramps.
- Audience: product-ops leads, SRE on-call, launch PM, release engineer, solutions engineer on standby.

Why a ‘Control Room’?
The goal is to reduce decision latency during activations: move from long email threads to a deterministic checklist + signal ladder so the team can quickly decide throttle/rollback/continue. This doc intentionally mixes quantitative thresholds with pragmatic steps.

Activation Signal Tiers (operational):
- Green: nominal. No action.
- Amber: monitor + prepare mitigation. Owner notified. Evaluate nearby thresholds in 15–30m.
- Red: active mitigation (throttle/cut traffic to fallback model/rollback). Mobilize owners and follow runbook.

KPI tracker (snapshot lines — update live in dashboard and copy back here pre-launch):
KPI | current | target | owner | gating_threshold
- Activation conversion (first 7d DAU->feature opt-in) | 3.2% | >=4.0% | Marco Gutierrez | Red if <2.0% at 24h
- 95th pct latency (token gen) | 410ms | <=350ms | Leah Kim | Amber if >450ms, Red if >700ms
- Request error rate (5xx/total) | 0.9% | <=0.5% | Omar Hassan | Amber if >1.5%, Red if >3.0%
- Cost per 1k tokens | $2.80 | <=$3.25 | Product-ops finance contact | Amber if >$4.50
- Model regression (eval pass rate) | 97% | >=98% | Research/ML | Red if <95% against regen-suite
- Customer-impact incidents (P2/P1) | 0 | 0 | PM oncall | Red if >=1 P1

Gating & Go/No-go heuristics (pre-launch):
- Hard blockers (must be green): basic infra SLOs (latency 95thpct < 500ms), infra autoscaler healthy (no >10% under-provision events in last 48h), security scan completed and signed off.
- Soft blockers: documentation complete (developer-facing), CS playbook drafted for first 7 days. Can be approved with mitigations.
- Rollout cadence: traffic ramp steps 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 60–90min observation windows (adjust by risk profile).

Owners & Escalation (primary then backup):
- Activation run lead: Aisha Patel (primary), Marco Gutierrez (backup)
- Runtime/SLOs: Leah Kim (primary), Samir Rao (backup)
- Incident lead (post-Red): Omar Hassan (primary), Priya Desai (backup)
- Customer comms: Nora James (CS), Marco for technical questions

Pre-launch checklist (short actionable items — mark DONE/NA/OPEN):
- [ ] Finalize canary config and routing policy (owner: release-engineering)
- [ ] Smoke test full stack with production-like load generator at 25% expected peak (owner: infra)
- [ ] Validate rollback path for model versioning and config flags (owner: serving-runtime)
- [ ] Confirm alerting thresholds are set and paging is tested (owner: observability)
- [ ] CS reactive playbook drafted and reviewed (owner: customer-success)
- [ ] Legal & compliance quick sign-off for customer data handling (owner: security-and-compliance)
- [ ] Cost guardrail configured (budget alert at +40% run rate) (owner: finance-and-legal)

Immediate 0–60m Red runbook (if Red signal fires):
1) Triage: Incident lead acknowledges and posts short summary to #launch-control Slack channel (include KPI snapshot).
2) Apply emergency throttle to 10% traffic or switch to fallback model variant (release-engineering).
3) Put a public-facing short note to affected customers (CS owned) and internal status update.
4) Run quick metric slices: region, model-variant, request size distribution.
5) If not resolvable within 30–60m, escalate to postmortem-run and maintain traffic at safety floor (5–10%).

Risk matrix & mitigations (high-level):
- Unanticipated model hallucination spike: mitigation = rate-limit, roll to vetted model snapshot, run targeted evals on failing prompts.
- Autoscaler oscillation under burst: mitigation = static buffer for 10m during ramp + increase cooldowns.
- Cost runaway: mitigation = budget guardrail + automated throttle to dedicated capacity fallback.
- Customer confusion: mitigation = pre-approved CS templates + rapid technical triage channel.

Measurement cadence & reporting:
- Live dashboard: update every 1m for latency/error, every 5m for conversion metrics.
- Control Room check-ins: at start of each ramp window, at 30m, at 60m then every hour up to 24h.
- Post-launch 72h report: one-pager with KPI deltas, incidents, rollouts, and recommended follow-up actions (owner: product-ops).

Open questions / TODOs:
- Define ‘acceptable UX jitter’ for multi-tenant customers (action: product-ux to propose).
- Confirm whether dedicated customers get separate guardrail thresholds; update alerting routing (action: solutions-eng).
- Add synthetic prompt suite for quick sanity checks (action: applied-ml).

Notes to self / team reminders (informal):
- Keep the first hour conservative; most surprises show up in the first backend cache miss spike.
- When in doubt, prefer a short throttle and fast communication vs silent continuation.
- Capture every deviation from expected and tag with the ramp step to help root cause analysis.

Appendix — short links & refs:
- Activation playbook (canon): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PROD/activation-playbook
- Canary config repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/launch-scripts
- Incident template: JIRA-INC-TEMPLATE

Last edited notes:
- 2026-02-28: tightened latency gating thresholds after infra SLO review.
- 2025-11-13: initial draft and signal ladder added.

(End of ledger)
